newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern Corp issue freed, tighter.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern Corp issue freed, tighter.

text.p: All eight tranches of Norfolk Southern Corp's $4.3 billion debt issue of Wednesday tightened two to six basis points when freed to trade on Friday, according to traders.

Norfolk Southern's three-year debt tightened from 36 basis points to 34 bid, 32 offered; four-year debt tightened from 39 basis points to 36 bid, 34 offered; five-year debt tightened from 45 basis points to 40 bid-lock; 10-year debt tightened from 67 basis points to 62 bid, 60 offered; 20-year debt tightened from 77 basis points to 71 bid, 69 offered; 30-year debt tightened from 87 basis points to 81 bid-lock; 40-year put seven debt tightened from 43 basis points to 39 bid, no offer; and 100-year debt tightened from 97 basis points to 91 bid, 89 offered.

Markets for the debt were moderately active at mid-morning, traders said, adding that hedge funds were heavily involved on the offer side. Joint lead underwriters J.P. Morgan Securities Inc and Merrill Lynch & Co Inc lifted syndicate restrictions at 0900 EDT/1300 GMT.
Other corporate activity was light with spreads mostly unchanged, traders added.
